scope: Whole chart HTML and nine selected modules with pinned real 4.2.3 drawing library; all requests intercepted, complete invented frames. Main, navigator and split source points, plus market recovery. No actual provider or application data.

model.source: FRED:invented_gap · 3 scalar observations · unit invented · D · 4 excluded records · observation dates, not release times · download checked_within_interval · upstream original evidence unverified

transformations: Strict finite scalar and calendar validation; sorted by period coordinate; equal duplicates plotted once; conflicting duplicates withheld; all records retained
Validate received normalized calendar dates without interpreting packet as_of as observation acquisition or first publication
observations.points_scope: Complete received warehouse obs array; upstream original history and transformations remain unverified

volume.reason: Not reported by this scalar observation series

observations.plotting_projection: Open/high/low/close are the same scalar, not market OHLC
observations.received_calendar_basis: Warehouse-normalized calendar dates. Native normalization may collapse periods and duplicates; original provider rows and period precision are unverified.

identity_resolution.rule: Full native directory id, case-insensitive; no suffix or substring matching

observations.display_projection: UTC calendar display groups retain first/minimum/maximum/last scalar; the line shows the last scalar. Weeks start Monday; two-week groups are anchored at 1970-01-05; 2/3/5-day groups are anchored at 1970-01-01; months and quarters start on their first day. Group starts are not source observation or release times. Original periods and every contributing ordinal remain retained. Missing volume stays unavailable.
